baseline.note: A name counts as this map's own only if it is absent from WaW's own zone files AND from the boilerplate shared by most maps in the corpus. Built by archive/stock_baseline.py and fed to scan_map.scan(baseline_path=..., ignore=...).

archive.catalogue_description: My 3rd map. After Zombie Folter i start this “project”, this is like Zombie Folter, a small map with a winnable ending -> same as zombie folter, but i think its harder. This is a small sized FUN map, i used to test my little experience at modding. -> No story for this -> Map made: 4-5 Days Map features: – Only Black Ops 1 guns – Ascension Power system – 5 Perks (Quick revive, speedcola, double tap, jugger, stamin up) – Winnable ending (after buy endgame trigger must survive for 10 rounds ) – Pack a Punch – !!6 Shootable teddy’s to open PaP and endgame!! – Custom vision – Small sized map – Difficulty: Hard – Little detail – Changed fov – Changed viewhands – Glowing zombie eyes – IMPORTANT: Jugger is fixed^^ – Zombie health little bit increase – Dr. Phil’s Ray gun – Removed dogs – UGX Jukebox with custom music – UGX easy-fx – New ammo counter hud!! (picture) – Map packed in UGX installer.. CREDIT LIST: – YaPh1l -> Zombie eyes / Typewriter intro / some help with scripting – UGX-Team -> Jukebox / easy-fx – BamSkater33 -> BO1 Perks – FRD -> Weapon files – UGX-Forum -> some help – ZM Forum -> some help – My Girlfriend <3 -> Beta tester / some ideas – If i forgot someone please tell me.

notes: Replaces common scripts (maps/_callbackglobal.gsc, maps/_gameskill.gsc, maps/_laststand.gsc, maps/_load.gsc, maps/_loadout.gsc); re-verify the generic down/revive/score events on it. Ships 2 executable(s): $PLUGINSDIR/System.dll, $PLUGINSDIR/nsDialogs.dll. NEVER RUN THEM (dev-box.md rule 3). PROVISIONAL: archive/corpus-ignore.json was missing, so corpus boilerplate was not subtracted and this finish may be a shared-script name; scan_maps.py --keep-existing rewrites this manifest.
